title: Change of frame for restricted vector integration chart prefixes
statement: Let N>0, let A be a finite commutative ring with (N:A)=0, fix a normalized finite Tate transport t, and let S be Noetherian with N invertible. Let F be a locally free O_S module of constant rank d, and U,V,V_prime opens with U contained in both V and V_prime. Given frames e on V and e_prime on V_prime, use the actual inverse-frame compact-support exchange, canonical coefficient comparison and inverse ordered-tower compact-support comparison to define chartPrefix. Restrict this prefix to U using the derived inverse-image compositor and affineTraceUnitBaseChange (the ordered affine exchange, right-functor base-change comparison and constant-unit comparison). There exists g in GL_d(Gamma(U,O_U)) such that overlapPrefix(e_prime) equals overlapPrefix(e) followed by the actual affineLinearTraceAction of g over U, with its canonical Cartesian-square certificate. There is no counit or trace in this conclusion. The constructions and maps are those of [def-amb-vector-integration-charts], [def-amb-affine-linear-trace-action] and [def-amb-affine-trace-construction], and the frames are those of [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section].

source.place: Overlap calculation: independence of the local vector trace under linear changes of frame; original local-compatibility node Steps 1--2, before application of the affine counit.

proof.text: Restrict the inverse-frame charts geometrically to U. Apply the coordinate-only overlap lemma to obtain an invertible matrix g with q_e′ = a_g followed by q_e. Both restricted chart squares are Cartesian by pasting.
Apply the one-frame restriction-transport theorem separately to e and e′. This identifies the two overlap prefixes with Cartesian prefixes using the same L and base coefficient comparison along U→S.

Apply the proved Cartesian-prefix action theorem to the equality q_e′=a_g followed by q_e. Its action is the prescribed affineLinearTraceAction with the canonical Cartesian certificate. Substitute the two single-frame comparison identities to obtain exactly the original equation. The local geometric properties and Noetherianness are supplied by vectorIntegration_geometry and restriction to an open.

proof_origin.place: Overlap calculation before the affine counit; the two local maps are identified by linear changes of frame.

theorem vectorIntegration_overlap_chart_prefix (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (d : ℕ)
    (F : SheafOfModules.{u} S.ringCatSheaf) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    (U V V' : S.Opens) (hUV : U ≤ V) (hUV' : U ≤ V')
    (e : VectorBundleZeroSection.Trivialization S d F V)
    (e' : VectorBundleZeroSection.Trivialization S d F V') :
    letI : TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace U.toScheme :=
      U.ι.isOpenEmbedding.isInducing.noetherianSpace
    letI : IsNoetherian U.toScheme :=
      { toIsLocallyNoetherian := inferInstance
        isCompact_univ := TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace.isCompact _ }
    ∃ g : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin d) Γ(U.toScheme, ⊤),
      vectorIntegrationOverlapPrefix N hN A hA t S hS d F U V' hUV' e' =
        vectorIntegrationOverlapPrefix N hN A hA t S hS d F U V hUV e ≫
          affineLinearTraceAction N hN A hA t U.toScheme
            (affineTracePullbackInvertible N U.ι hS) d
            (affineTraceLinearMap U.toScheme d g) (affineTraceLinearMap_isPullback _ _ g)
